  MINUTES
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  October 14, 2019

A meeting of the Claims Review Committee was held in the Council Chambers, 9th floor at
11:45 a.m.:

  Members Present: Yvonne Horton, City Clerk Department
  Wanda Brown, City Treasurer Department
  Maria Heaney, Finance Department

  Staff Present:  Stephanie Maldonado, Parks and Rec Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
  Maria Heaney reported no public comments.

  1. The minutes of October 07, 2019, meeting was approved as recorded.

  2. Beacon Security, Inc. – Executive session to discuss recommended payment for
  providing services of monitoring and the fire detection services for the Centinela Adobe
  in the amount of $825.00. Motion carried unanimously.

  3. Shelli Boone – Executive session to discuss recommended payment for providing
  service’s as the Artistic Director for the Willie Agee Playhouse in the amount of
  $5,000.00. Motion carried unanimously.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
  Maria Heaney reported no public comments.

  There being no further business, the meeting adjourned at 11:53 p.m. Adjournment
